sql: SELECT DISTINCT installment_ref FROM accolade WHERE accolade_class = 'Primetime Emmy'
SELECT DISTINCT t1.natal_zone FROM individual AS t1 INNER JOIN recognition AS t2 ON t1.individual_ref = t2.individual_ref WHERE t2.capacity = 'assistant location manager'

SELECT DISTINCT a.annum, a.installment_ref FROM accolade AS a INNER JOIN individual AS i ON a.individual_ref = i.individual_ref WHERE i.moniker = 'Constantine Makris' AND a.outcome = 'Winner' AND a.prize = 'Television' AND a.accolade_class = 'Silver Gavel Award' AND a.body = 'American Bar Association Silver Gavel Awards for Media and the Arts'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM installment AS t1 INNER JOIN accolade AS t2 ON t1.installment_ref = t2.installment_ref WHERE t2.annum = 1999 AND t2.outcome = 'Nominee' AND t1.installment_ordinal = 20 AND t2.body = 'Primetime Emmy Awards' AND t1.franchise = 'Law and Order'

SELECT t3.installment_ref, t2.capacity FROM individual AS t1 INNER JOIN accolade AS t2 ON t1.individual_ref = t2.individual_ref INNER JOIN installment AS t3 ON t2.installment_ref = t3.installment_ref WHERE t2.annum = 1999 AND t2.prize = 'Outstanding Guest Actress in a Drama Series' AND t2.body = 'Primetime Emmy Awards' AND t1.moniker = 'Julia Roberts'
